detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Return of the Old Gods

The Old Gods, shrouded in curses, painted with the brush of villainy, forsaken and lost to memory.

Yet, they were the silent sentinels, guiding humanity to their current abode, shielding them in their darkest hours. And though they now lie dormant in the shadows of oblivion, their return looms inevitable.

Description of new content

A new parallel path has been added to the main quest, introducing a new game ending, new side quests, and interactions with the old gods.

This expansion centers around the old gods and will offer players the chance to push the story toward the light side with them.

The idea is to add more combat and expand on everything you love in the core game.

  • A new parallel main story branch with an alternate game ending

  • A new area to explore

  • Two new character classes

  • Devotion and relationship mechanics with gods

  • Faction Wars with the option to conquer the whole world with one of six factions

  • Over 30 new side quests

  • Over 60 new world events and an expanded world chaos system

  • Over 120 new items, including cursed gear, off-hand weapons, and more

  • Over 100 devotion shrines, adding more action to the game

  • New mechanics such as fishing, gardening, and traveling by cart

  • A more dynamic world with more roaming traders and beasts

  • Expanded crime and mercenary systems

  • First World dungeons

  • Headhunting quests, new enemy types, and new boss battles
